claims.description: The report provides a requirement-by-requirement decision-to-evidence matrix for MMT-ADR-0036 and the ratified mentor-notice MVP specification.

Fresh unit, prompt, mobile, and real-database evidence covers eligibility/exclusion, all-age authority, self/proxy privacy, proposal evidence, both transports and fallback, concurrency, one-actionable projection, all lifecycle outcomes, cap semantics, learning-day defer, fade, minimal persistence, ordered flag-off, and zero MVP push delivery.

Static inspection covers runtime schemas, migrations and rollback, centralized services, API/SSE/mobile parsing, job registration, configuration, and deployment manifests; no contradictory active legacy path remains.
Applicable focused and complete gates include explicit negative controls. Native-device Maestro was unavailable and is bounded without claiming unexecuted coverage.
The one initial in-scope finding was recorded and corrected through existing WI-2629; exact final-base retesting found no unresolved ADR or friendly-user MVP safety-boundary violation.
The report, completion summary, evidence manifest, PR body, and sanitized revision-pinned database receipt provide durable evidence for independent Cosmo review and QA.
